meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 你要规划功能、任务或多步实现时，它会先派子代理查文档和示例，弄清楚哪些接口真的存在，再给出一份分阶段计划。每阶段都有依据的文档、验证方法，以及要避免的坑，最后整体检查一遍。
howto.when: 当用户要求规划某个功能、任务或多步实现时触发，尤其当接下来要动手执行这些步骤时。

say.text: 帮我规划一个用户登录功能，先查现有文档再给分阶段实施计划。
say.note: 先做文档调研，再生成分阶段计划。

say.text: 给“数据迁移”做一份分阶段实施计划，每阶段写清验证清单和文档出处。
say.note: 计划里会带验证清单和文档引用。

say.text: 我想实现导出报表功能，先识别可用的接口，再按阶段规划并列出禁止事项。
say.note: 它会按文档核对接口，并标注需要避免的写法。

howto.what_en: On planning requests, Claude first runs documentation discovery (subagents find real APIs), then produces a phased plan: each phase has tasks, doc refs, verification checklist, and anti-pattern guards, with a final verification.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a user asks to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially before executing with do.

say_en.text: Plan a user login feature. Check docs first, then give a phased plan.
Plan data migration in phases; each phase needs verification and doc refs.
say_en.note: Produces phased plan with verification and doc refs.

say_en.text: Plan report export: check available APIs, then phased plan with anti-patterns.
say_en.note: Limit the plan to real APIs and note what to avoid.
